{{Top|ga|audio=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gbtsrrEPoX0}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:TytanLatimer-DoRTVG.png]] |name=Tytan Latimer |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Kenobi|Part IV}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Ginger]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Galactic Empire]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|No admittance without clearance.''"
"''I have officer class C.''"
"''Now, please.|Tytan Latimer and Tala Durith|audio=NoAdmittance-Latimer-Durith-PartIV.flac|}} '''Tytan Latimer''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[security guard]] in [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] [[Nur]] by [[9 BBY]]. The lead security on his level, Latimer held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. The [[Security officer|officer]] operated a [[security scanner]] and stood at ease when the [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] passed through. Later on, Latimer stopped the Imperial [[Captain]] [[Tala Durith]] when she tried to pass through, demanding her identification. Latimer inspected her [[code cylinder]] and found that Nur was not Durith's [[sector]]. However, Durith pressured Latimer into letting her through regardless by threatening to report him to [[the Grand Inquisitor]] for insolence and claiming she was working with classified information. ==Biography== {{Quote|Is there a problem?''"
"''This isn't your sector. I can't let you through.|Durith and Latimer|audio=WrongSector-Latimer-Durith-PartIV.flac|}} During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Tytan Latimer served as an Imperial [[security guard]] by [[9 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Part IV]]" to [[9 BBY]]. and held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. Latimer operated at [[Fortress Inquisitorius]], the headquarters of the Empire's [[Jedi hunter|Jedi-hunting]] group—the [[Inquisitorius]]—on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] of [[Nur]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. There, he was the lead security for his level of the [[fortress]], below the [[Water|sea]] level of Nur, and stood at the control station of a [[DeTECHt]] model [[security scanner]] at the end of a grand concourse One [[Standard day|day]] that [[Standard year|year]], the [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] arrived at Fortress Inquisitorius and passed through the security scanner while Latimer was on duty, the [[Security officer|officer]] standing at ease at the scanner's control station as she passed.{{Kenobi|Part III}} [[File:Durith-Latimer-Part4.png|thumb|left|350px|Tytan Latimer confronts Tala Durith.]] Sometime later, Latimer was posted at the gate when the [[Imperial officer]] [[Tala Durith]] arrived at the fortress, secretly working with the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|break out]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the ten-year-old daughter of Imperial [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]],{{Kenobi|Part I}} who had been [[Prison|imprisoned]] by the Third Sister. As Durith approached the security scanner, Latimer asked for identification. Durith ignored Latimer, so he left his terminal and told her she needed clearance, his visitor replying that she had [[officer class C]]. Latimer persisted and took Durith's [[code cylinder]] for inspection and found that Nur was not in her [[sector]]. The security guard thus informed Durith that he could not let her through, only for her to ask about his position and assert herself as his [[commanding officer]]. She further claimed that she would inform [[the Grand Inquisitor]] of his insolence as her supposed mission involved classified information. Latimer stiffened and swallowed, resigning to Durith's demands and letting the [[officer]] pass through the gate while he stood at ease. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I am the lead security on this level.''"
"''Then I'm your commanding officer, and you will address me as 'Sir.'''"
"''Yes, sir, of course.|Latimer and Durith|audio=LeadSecurity-Latimer-Durith-PartIV.flac|}} [[File:Obi-Wan_Kenobi_Part_IV.png|thumb|right|300px|Latimer at his control station]] A [[human]], Tytan Latimer had [[Color|light]] skin, blue [[eye]]s, and ginger [[hair]]. He was assertive of the identification protocols to Tala Durith, persistently refusing to let her pass without clearance. He was also submissive to higher-ranking individuals, immediately complying with Durith's correction to call her "sir" and stiffening when she implied repercussions from the [[Grand Inquisitor]]. ==Equipment== Latimer wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]], including an [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]], black [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s, and a black [[belt]] with compartments and a silver buckle featuring an officer's disk. The security guard bore two code cylinders, slotted above each [[breast]], and a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left breast displaying three blue tiles in a horizontal row. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:JossGlennieSmith.png|thumb|right|240px|Tytan Latimer was portrayed by the actor Joss Glennie-Smith.]] Tytan Latimer first appeared in "[[Part III]]" of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', released on [[June 1]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}} He was portrayed by actor [[Joss Glennie-Smith]], who was not credited as the actor until the character's appearance in the following episode, "[[Part IV]]," released a [[June 8|week later]]. The character's name was identified in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' within a section written by [[Emily Shkoukani]]..{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}} The book was first published on [[November 2]] of that year,{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241666371-star-wars-dawn-of-rebellion-the-visual-guide|text=Star Wars Dawn of Rebellion The Visual Guide}} but a relevant extract identifying Latimer was previewed earlier in the year at the [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]] on [[July 21]].{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} In one shot in "Part IV," an Imperial officer in Fortress Inquisitorius with the same uniform as Latimer bar a differing rank plaque is described to be wearing the "darker uniforms of non-commissioned officers" by the episode's audio description. It is unclear if this description also applies to Latimer. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Tytan Latimer|imagecat=Images of Tytan Latimer}} *{{Kenobi|Part III}} {{1st}} *{{Kenobi|Part IV}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/obi-wan-kenobi/part-iv-guide|text=Part IV Episode Guide | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} {{1stID|Tytan Latimer}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|76|History of the Ship}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Tytan Latimer |fr=Tytan Latimer |ja=タイタン・ラティマー |ka=ტაიტან ლატიმერი |nl=Tytan Latimer }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Latimer, Tytan}} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]]
